correctness.rationale: Cited Lemma 4.4 proves a bijection to endpoint lengths 1/2 and internal lengths 2/3. Each block gives defect binomial(length,2); solving n=2+e+2u+3v and d=e+u+3v yields the exact binomial coefficient formula and rational generating function. For every odd n>=11 and even n>=14 the displayed three consecutive coefficients form a strict valley; all remaining n=2..10 and 12 have explicitly listed unimodal vectors. The published nonstandard lemma was inspected at its full-text proof and independently checked against actual maximal Lehmer code posets through n=9. The included verifier is finite corroboration, not an infinity proof.

originality.rationale: The assessed proposition is the exact full-length unimodality classification (including the n=12 restoration) of the maximal-code defect profile. The source already proves its block structure and defect summands, hence these are credited and not treated as independent novelty. Its Theorems 1.4 and 1.5 give total Padovan cardinality and maximum weight, not the coefficient-profile shape; the all-length coefficient valleys and sharp exception are additional rank-distribution conclusions. Actual published-finding corpus and public searches returned no covering full threshold. This is self-review, not an independence or exhaustive literature guarantee.

value.rationale: The question concerns a canonical, naturally graded antichain of maximal elements in a recently introduced combinatorial poset. The known Padovan cardinality and extremal inversion weight do not indicate whether its internal coefficient profile is unimodal. The sharp eventual failure and isolated length-12 recovery constitute a complete and non-obvious classification, proved uniformly for infinitely many n; it is not an arbitrary fixed-size count or a trivial rewriting of the scalar Padovan identity.
